Global options such as `--base-url`, `--tenant` and `--json` go before the command — see [CLI reference](./index.mdx#global-options). Exit codes are listed in [Exit codes](./exit-codes.md).

## apiome usage {#usage}

Feed the runtime usage index: upload recorded traffic (HAR) as usage events.

```text
apiome usage [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

Subcommands: [`upload`](#usage-upload).

## apiome usage upload {#usage-upload}

Upload a HAR file as usage events (POST …/usage/ingest).

Field presence is computed from the bodies on this machine; the bodies, query values and header values are never sent. Exit 0 uploaded, 2 parse error or rejected request (auth included), 1 unreachable.

```text
apiome usage upload [OPTIONS] FILE
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `FILE` | path | yes | The HAR file (browser devtools or proxy recording). |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--project` | text |  | yes | Project slug or UUID the traffic is for. |
| `--environment` | text |  | yes | Environment the traffic happened in (prod, staging, ...). mock is reserved. |
| `--source` | text |  |  | A har usage source id of the project. Default: the project's har source for the environment (created when there is none). |
| `--sample-bodies` | flag |  |  | Also send redacted body samples. Refused unless the source's body window is open. |
